note: Forest Service campground in a maple stand on the east shore of 955-acre Kentuck Lake, east of Eagle River, with a paved boat landing and a 2.5-mile trail to Spectacle Lake campground. --Claude
summary: FS page, rec.gov facility/rates/catalog read. 31 sites, 13 electric (20/30/50 on catalog sites 1-2), $15-28, reservable late May-Labor Day (some sites), FCFS otherwise. Stored lakeview confirmed: the six $28 'lakeside' sites sit 35-65 m from the shore under maple canopy behind a shoreline tree band. Season 04-30..11-30 (manual) matches. Pin ~205 m east of the loop centroid (under 250 m).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview kept. Rec.gov tags 01, 02, 04, 05, 06, 08 'Lakefront' and the FS prices 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8 as lakeside ($18/$28, nightly sites; 2, 6, 8 reservable, 1, 4, 5 first-come). On Esri imagery they sit about 35 m (06: 45.99123,-88.98208), 40 m (05: 45.99147,-88.98190), 47 m (04: 45.99162,-88.98172), 65 m (02, 08) from the shore, all under the maple canopy with a continuous band of shoreline trees between; no open ground to the water. That is a view, not lakefront.

HOOKUPS: rec.gov's facility notice says 'Hookups are not available', but the catalog types 13 sites STANDARD ELECTRIC with '20/30/50' on 01-02 and the FS page charges for 'Single Site with electric hook-up'. Electric kept (50 per the catalog); the notice looks stale.
SITE 07: absent from the rec.gov catalog (30 sites) though the FS counts 31 and lists 7 among the 40-ft sites.
PIN: 45.9909,-88.9788 is on the entrance road ~205 m ESE of the site centroid (45.99226,-88.98058); under 250 m, optional move.
SEASON: manual 04-30..11-30 matches the FS 'April 30 - November 30'; untouched. 2027 the same. Reservations open only for the peak season (2027-05-27..09-06).
PHONE 715-479-2827 confirmed (FS district office; rec.gov the same). WEBSITES both live.
